name: Light Fades Twice Lizalfos + Chilfos PRIVATE TEST
author: Dusklight community mods
description: 0.13.2 CHILFOS FIX02 over Lizalfos FIX05 0.12.5 (Lizalfos unchanged). The Chilfos (E_KK) fights with four learnable combos of diagonal slashes and thrusts (one ends with a backstep, a real spear throw and a fast restore); its fast double thrusts play at x1.10. Its spear never breaks when it blocks or parries; under repeated frontal swings it blocks and parries more and more, and counters after every parry. Below 100 posture Link's sword and Shield Attack never stagger it; no recoil slide on shield contacts. 340 HP, 0..100 posture; at 100 it staggers for 3 s: a new sword hit, or a Shield Attack then Helm Splitter, kills it natively. HUMAN_RUNTIME_PENDING. Replace only this ID; rollback 0.13.1.
